note:
Lincoln Circus on the 1901 census, read from the enumerator's page and checked by A. Hagues.

**The Palmers are filed at The Cottage (#414), and this is the first schedule to name the house outright.** Schedule 188 is headed "The Cottage, Lincoln Circus" and gives Edward Palmer, a domestic gardener of 40 born in Scotland, his wife Alice, five children and a visitor. The record places the Palmers at The Cottage in 1911 and returns them at 2 Lincoln Circus in 1921 - the same family in the same house, ten years earlier, with the house named on the page instead of reasoned out. See [[lincoln-circus-numbers]].

**One house on the circus stood empty on census night**, which is recorded in [[empty-houses-census-night-1901]] rather than here.
source: 1901 census enumerator's page for Lincoln Circus, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
